sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Kumar Shukla,Ramji Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vijay Kumar Dubey
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant-accused in case crime No. 0484 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Mahuli, District Sant Kabir Nagar with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is father-in-law of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with son of applicant has taken place on 05.02.2022.

It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons,

sentences.text: No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
It was further submitted that deceased has suffered abortion for two times and she was under depression and she has has committed suicide due to that reason.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 02.10.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4.

Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances within a period of seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Daya Shankar involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court below shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Anand  Daya Shankar vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6444787/
